data.name: Psychic Combatant
data.description: You are skilled at attacking opponents in psychic duels. You gain an extra pool of manifestation points with a number of points equal to 1/2 your character level. You can use these points at any time during a psychic duel. When you are not participating in a psychic duel, you can spend 1 of these extra manifestation points as a swift action to gain a +1 bonus on saving throws against psychic spells until the start of your next turn, or 3 points as a swift action to gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against psychic spells until the start of your next turn. This pool refreshes at the start of each day.
